candles.description: Primary market candle series, ordered newest-first by ts_sec.

nextPageToken.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

referenceCandles.description: Composite reference market candle series, ordered newest-first by ts_sec. Populated only when include_reference is true and reference data is available.

symbol.description: Trading pair symbol echoed from the request path, e.g. BTC-USDT.

timeframe.description: Candle bucket size used for the returned series.

assets.description: Assets ordered by asset code in ascending alphabetical order.

includedInEquity.description: Counted in the account's total equity. When false, balances of this asset are still reported but carry no value in total equity. Always set; treat an absent value as unknown, never as false.

ledgerId.description: Stable numeric asset id used by account, balance, and order APIs.

marketDataVolumeScale.description: Integer scale for public candle and market-overview base volume (0..18).

quantityDisplayDecimals.description: Suggested decimal precision for displaying user-facing asset amounts.

quantityScale.description: Decimal scale (0..18) for this asset's order quantities and other fields that explicitly reference quantity_scale. A scale of 8 represents one whole asset as 100000000 in those fields. Account balance amounts use fixed 18-decimal units independently of this value.

maxOpenOrdersTotal.description: The venue's default limit on resting orders a typical account may hold across all pairs together: good-till-cancelled and good-till-date orders that have not ended. Immediate-or-cancel, fill-or-kill and market orders never count, and a replaced order keeps its place. An order past it is rejected with MAX_OPEN_ORDERS_TOTAL. Each pair's own limit is PairConfig.max_open_orders_per_pair. An account may have a lower limit of its own; that is not part of this public configuration and would be returned by an account-scoped read.

pairs.description: Pairs ordered by symbol in ascending alphabetical order.

allowBuyFeeFromBase.description: Whether BUY order fees may be paid from the base asset instead of the spent quote asset when the order request selects the base fee asset.

baseAsset.description: Base asset code. For BTC-USDT, this is "BTC".

baseQuantityScale.description: Quantity scale for base-asset amounts in this pair.

defaultMarketSlippageBpsBuy.description: Default MARKET order slippage cap for BUY orders, in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%). A request-level slippage setting can override this value.

defaultMarketSlippageBpsSell.description: Default MARKET order slippage cap for SELL orders, in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%). A request-level slippage setting can override this value.

delistingAt.description: Scheduled delisting timestamp. When unset, the pair has no explicit delisting time.

listingAt.description: Scheduled listing timestamp. When unset, the pair has no explicit future listing time.

marketdata.description: Market-data display settings for this pair.

orderbookPriceBuckets.description: Suggested order book aggregation bucket sizes in quote-asset price units, e.g. 0.01, 0.1, 1, or 10.

maxClientRefDriftBps.description: Maximum allowed drift between client reference price and server reference price for MARKET orders, in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%), when client reference pricing is used.

maxLimitQtyBase.description: Largest quantity of one limit order, as a decimal string in base-asset units. A replace is checked on its new total less the quantity already filled. An order above it is rejected with MAX_QTY. Absent when the pair has no maximum.

maxMarketNotionalQuote.description: Additional maximum notional for market orders as a decimal string in quote-asset units. Base-sized market orders are valued at the buy protection price or the sell reference price before slippage, without rounding. For quote-sized market buys, the entire all-in maximum quote debit must also fit this maximum, and for quote-sized market sells the entire quote proceeds target. Exceeding it returns MAX_NOTIONAL. Absent when no maximum is configured.

maxMarketQtyBase.description: Largest quantity of one market order, as a decimal string in base-asset units. A market order sized by quote amount is checked once converted to base. An order above it is rejected with MAX_QTY. Absent when the pair has no maximum.

maxOpenOrdersPerPair.description: The venue's default limit on resting orders a typical account may hold on this pair at once: good-till-cancelled and good-till-date orders that have not ended. Immediate-or-cancel, fill-or-kill and market orders never count, and a replaced order keeps its place. An order past it is rejected with MAX_OPEN_ORDERS_PER_PAIR. An account may have a lower limit of its own; that is not part of this public configuration and would be returned by an account-scoped read.

maxOrderNotionalQuote.description: Maximum per-order notional as a decimal string in quote-asset units. Base-sized orders are checked using quantity times limit price, or market protection price, without rounding. For quote-sized buys, the entire all-in maximum quote debit must also fit this maximum, and for quote-sized sells the entire quote proceeds target. Exceeding it returns MAX_NOTIONAL. Absent when no maximum is configured.

minNotionalQuote.description: Minimum order notional as a decimal string in quote-asset units.

minQtyBase.description: Minimum order quantity as a decimal string in base-asset units.

priceBand.description: The pair's price band. Absent when the pair has none.

lowerBps.description: How far below the reference price a sell may be priced or trade, in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%). The lower limit is the reference price times (1 - lower_bps / 10000), rounded up to the tick size.

referenceWindowMs.description: How long the reference price stays fixed before it can move to a newer trade, in milliseconds. Zero moves it with every order.

upperBps.description: How far above the reference price a buy may be priced or trade, in basis points. The upper limit is the reference price times (1 + upper_bps / 10000), rounded down to the tick size.

quoteAsset.description: Quote asset code. For BTC-USDT, this is "USDT".

quoteQuantityScale.description: Quantity scale for quote-asset amounts in this pair.

referencePriceScale.description: Integer scale for composite reference prices in candle responses (0..18). Primary market and execution prices use the fixed scale 9.

stepSize.description: Minimum allowed quantity increment as a decimal string in base-asset units.

symbolId.description: Stable numeric pair id used by low-latency ConnectRPC requests and streams.

tickSize.description: Minimum allowed price increment as a decimal string in quote-asset units. Prices use 9 decimal places in scaled integer fields; for example "0.01" means orders must be priced in 0.01 quote-asset increments.

tsSec.description: Snapshot generation timestamp, in seconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).

completeThroughTradeId.description: With afterTradeId only: every trade with matchId at or below it exists and is returned by this endpoint.

epochEnds.description: Set only with after_trade_id. Every epoch whose last trade (or, for an epoch without trades, its start) lies between after_trade_id and next_after_trade_id, both inclusive, ascending by epoch. A page that ends exactly on an epoch's last trade is followed by a page that still reports that epoch's end.

lastTradeId.description: match_id of the epoch's last trade; (epoch-1) * 2^40 when the epoch ended without trades.

nextAfterTradeId.description: With afterTradeId only: the afterTradeId of the next call. It never moves backwards; equal to the request's afterTradeId when nothing newer is available yet.

nextPageToken.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist, and always empty with after_trade_id.

trades.description: Trades ordered newest-first by execution timestamp, with match_id as a tie-breaker; with after_trade_id, ascending by match_id.

executedAt.description: Trade execution timestamp, in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).

matchId.description: Stable trade id within the symbol, suitable for pagination and de-duplication.

price.description: Trade price as a decimal string in quote asset units per base asset unit, for example '61000.25'.

qty.description: Traded quantity as a decimal string in base asset units, for example '0.001'.

side.description: True when the taker/aggressor bought the base asset; false when the taker/aggressor sold the base asset.

symbol.description: Stable numeric pair id from GetSpotConfig.

assetInfo.description: Complete finite result, ordered by ascending asset_id. No pagination.

description.description: Plain text description, at most 10000 characters. Render as text.

discordUrl.description: Official HTTPS Discord URL, at most 2048 bytes.

explorerUrls.description: Up to 10 HTTPS block explorer URLs, each at most 2048 bytes; editorial order.

githubUrl.description: Official HTTPS GitHub URL, at most 2048 bytes.

issueDate.description: Launch calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD, or empty when unknown.

amount.description: Nonnegative decimal string, at most 64 characters; no exponent or sign.

telegramUrl.description: Official HTTPS Telegram URL, at most 2048 bytes.

websiteUrl.description: Official HTTPS website, at most 2048 bytes.

whitepaperUrl.description: HTTPS whitepaper URL, at most 2048 bytes.

xUrl.description: Official HTTPS X profile URL, at most 2048 bytes.

editorialUpdatedAt.description: Time of the last effective editorial change, in UTC.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ENABLED: New orders and cancellations are accepted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.HALTED: Trading is halted: only cancellations are accepted, and new orders are rejected with MARKET_HALTED.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POST_ONLY: New orders must use a post-only execution variant.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REDUCE_ONLY: New spot orders are blocked by reduce-only policy.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.BUY: Return trades where the taker/aggressor was buying the base asset.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SELL: Return trades where the taker/aggressor was selling the base asset.

BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.

info.description:
Public trading API for market makers and integrators.
Connect RPC over HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 with JSON and Protobuf.
info.title: Polyester API

get.description: Read team-maintained asset information. Empty assetIds returns all saved entries, ordered by ascending assetId. Never-edited assets and unknown IDs are omitted. Empty fields mean unknown. Cacheable for 60 seconds.

parameters.description: Optional numeric asset IDs matching ledgerId in spot config; repeated assetIds query parameters, at most 1000. Empty means all.
parameters.name: assetIds

editorial.description: Example configuration for the API playground.

get.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

get.description: Retrieve a cacheable snapshot of spot assets and pairs, including precision and trading constraints.
get.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

get.description: Retrieve OHLCV candles for a spot symbol and timeframe, ordered newest first. Supports inclusive time bounds, optional current open candle inclusion, and optional composite reference candles.

parameters.description: Filter candles with bucket start time at or before this time (inclusive, RFC3339).
parameters.name: endTime

parameters.description: Include the current open candle when available. It is prepended to the newest-first candle list and does not count toward limit.
parameters.name: includeIncomplete

parameters.description: Include the composite reference market candle series when available.
parameters.name: includeReference

parameters.description: Maximum closed candles to return. Default 500, max 10000.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response.
parameters.name: pageToken

parameters.description: Filter candles with bucket start time at or after this time (inclusive, RFC3339).
parameters.name: startTime

parameters.description: Candle bucket timeframe, such as 1m, 5m, 1h, or 1d.
parameters.name: timeframe

get.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

get.description: Retrieve recent public trades for a spot symbol, ordered newest first. Supports optional aggressor side, inclusive time-range, and opaque page-token pagination filters. With afterTradeId, walks the symbol's trades by trade identifier, oldest first and gap-free, to backfill trades missed on a live stream.

parameters.description: Exclusive trade-identifier cursor (unsigned 64-bit decimal string) for gap-free backfill: returns trades with matchId above it, ascending, up to completeThroughTradeId. Use 0 to start from the first trade, then nextAfterTradeId. Cannot be combined with side, startTime, endTime or pageToken.
parameters.name: afterTradeId

parameters.description: Filter trades executed at or before this time (inclusive, RFC3339)
parameters.name: endTime

parameters.description: Maximum trades to return. Default 100, max 1000.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response.
parameters.name: pageToken

parameters.description: Filter by aggressor side. BUY means the taker bought the base asset; SELL means the taker sold the base asset.
parameters.name: side

parameters.description: Filter trades executed at or after this time (inclusive, RFC3339)
parameters.name: startTime

get.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.
